description: Source code for the abstract class 'Task' in Apache Spark, defining task execution logic, context management, and resource handling within Spark's scheduler component.

classes.name: Task
classes.description: Abstract class representing a unit of execution in Spark, managing task lifecycle, context, and resource handling.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the task, managing context setup, resource registration, and cleanup after execution.

methods.name: setTaskMemoryManager
methods.description: Assigns a TaskMemoryManager to the task.

methods.name: runTask
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented with the task's specific execution logic.

methods.name: preferredLocations
methods.description: Returns preferred task locations for data locality.

methods.name: collectAccumulatorUpdates
methods.description: Collects and returns accumulator updates after task execution.

methods.name: kill
methods.description: Kills the task, optionally interrupting its thread, and records the reason.
